name: canvas-course-builder
tagline_zh: 从零搭一门课？别手动点模块、页、作业了。给它一份大纲或旧课，它批量生成完整结构，连讨论区都铺好。
tagline_en: Stop clicking. Give it a spec or old course, and it scaffolds modules, pages, assignments, and discussions in one.
desc_en: Scaffold complete Canvas LMS course structures from specs, templates, or existing courses. Creates modules, pages, assignments, and discussions in bulk. Use when asked to "build a course", "scaffold modules", "create course structure", "set up a new course", or "copy course structure".
why_zh: 同类工具只建空壳，它连讨论区都铺好，还能从现有课程反向复制结构，省掉最烦的重复劳动。
why_en: Unlike shell-only scaffolders, it clones real course structures and pre-creates discussions, saving the most tedious bulk work.
